मत्वा|matvā|man — to think, consider (matvā: gerund, 'having thought, considering')

यदुक्तं|yat uktam|yat — which, what (relative pronoun, nom./acc. sg. neut., correlated with tat in the next verse);;vac — to speak (uktam: past participle 'said'; -t + u- → -d u-, written joined as yaduktam)

वापि|vā api|vā — or (disjunctive particle);;api — even, also (emphatic particle; vā + api → -ā + a- → -ā-, the short a of api elided)

यच्चावहासार्थमसत्कृतोऽसि|yat ca avahāsa-artham asatkṛtaḥ asi|yat — which, what (relative pronoun, picking up alongside yad uktam of the previous verse; -t + c- → -c c-, written yacca);;ca — and;;avahāsa — mockery, joking, ridicule (avahāsa-artham: 'for the sake of a joke', first compound member; -a + a- → -ā-, written joined);;artha — purpose, sake (avahāsārtham: acc. sg. neut. used adverbially, second compound member; written joined with the following word, -m + a- unchanged);;a-sat-kṛta — treated improperly, disrespected (asatkṛtaḥ: past participle, nom. sg. masc., 'you were treated with disrespect'; -aḥ + a- → -o-, the following a- elided, marked by avagraha);;as — to be (asi: present 2nd sg.
